case_name: Vijay Gupta And Others vs Deeksha Sharma And Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Vijay Gupta and others (father, mother, sister)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner No.1 is the father, petitioner No.2 is the mother, and petitioner No.3 is the sister of respondent No.2. Respondent No.1 filed a case under Protection of Women against Domestic Violence Act. Petitioners are respondents in that case.

legal_principles.principle: The Trial Court lacks jurisdiction to try an offence if it was not committed within its local limits.
legal_principles.held: Section 177 of the Code of Criminal Procedure lays down the jurisdiction of the Court to try an offence in terms that every offence shall ordinarily be enquired into and tried by the Court within local limits of whose jurisdiction the same was committed;

legal_principles.principle: A spouse cannot be criminally prosecuted for bigamy if the second marriage was not solemnized during the subsistence of a legal and valid first marriage.
legal_principles.held: The Section 494 particularly provides that the offence thereunder is committed by either spouse, who remarries during the subsistence of a legal and a valid marriage, whereas, in the present case the cognizance against the petitioners has been taken for commission of the offences under section 494 IPC which is legally not permissible;

outcome.final_order: The impugned complaint and order dated 05.03.2020 were quashed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
